children.text: Understanding Biblical Prophecy and Preparing for the End Times

"Where Did Everyone Go?" is a biblical guide designed to help people understand the Rapture and end times prophecy. This book serves as a beacon of hope and truth for those seeking answers about biblical prophecy and God's plan for the last days.

To provide clear, biblical answers about the Rapture and end times events. We believe that understanding God's prophetic timeline brings hope, comfort, and urgency to live for Christ. Our mission is to help believers prepare their hearts and share the Gospel before the Lord's return.

This comprehensive resource covers: The timing of the Rapture, The 14 events of the Rapture, Signs of the times and birth pains, The Great Tribulation period, God's prophetic timeline, The Bride of Christ and the Wedding, How to receive salvation through Jesus Christ, and Living with hope and purpose in the last days.

This book was written with a heart for souls and a deep love for God's Word. The author's desire is to see people come to know Jesus Christ as their personal Savior and to help believers understand the blessed hope of the Rapture.

children.text: Connect with believers seeking to understand biblical prophecy and prepare for the end times.

The WDEG community brings together believers from all walks of life who are seeking to understand biblical prophecy and prepare their hearts for the Lord's return. Our platform provides a safe space for fellowship, study, and spiritual growth.

• Bible Study Groups - Join online and local groups studying end times prophecy and biblical truth
• Prayer Circles - Connect with fellow believers for prayer and spiritual support
• Testimony Sharing - Share how God is working in your life and preparing your heart
• Prophecy Discussions - Engage in thoughtful conversations about current events and biblical prophecy
• Resource Library - Access recommended books, sermons, and study materials
• Event Notifications - Stay informed about conferences, revivals, and community gatherings

Whether you're a new believer seeking to understand God's plan or a mature Christian looking to deepen your knowledge of prophecy, our community welcomes you. We believe in supporting one another as we watch and wait for our Lord's return.

Have questions about biblical prophecy or want to connect with other believers in your area? We'd love to hear from you. Contact us through our contact page or join one of our online fellowship groups.
